citation.title: Lateral cephalometry in 100 Harbin children with normal occlusion
citation.journal: Chung-Hua Kou Chiang Ko Tsa Chih (Chinese Journal of Stomatology)

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08: norms:compare a vs b exit 1, 9 differences (logs/task9a2-compare-<id>.log). Every mean and SD of both extractors re-read from the page images (PDF pp. 2-6 = journal pp. 20-24), and the settled file checked by script against a third, independent reading of the pages (the table in sets.test.ts). Decisions: (0) Source text normalised to one pattern giving table, page, row and column with sex and age (a and b worded it differently; prose only). b's UFH:LFH% rows (#29) not entered: the merge notes rule the printed UFH:LFH ratio is not a catalogue measurement (do not compute ratios). (1) Selection a class-I / b class-I-balanced -> class-I (no profile criterion in the text, p. 21). Page images: PDF pp. 2-6 = journal pp. 20-24 (Tables I-VI), rendered at 2000 px.

caveats: Quoted second-hand from Moate & Darendeliler 2002 (Aust Orthod J 18:19-26, a compilation of published Chinese cephalometric norms), Table II; the original paper was not read. The compilation rounds every mean and SD to whole numbers (Lew's soft tissue to 0.5) and gives no landmark, plane or method definitions.
The compilation states no film scale or magnification for any study; assumed true size (owner ruling M-2).

100 Harbin children (northern China), average age 12, selected from 11,988 children (text p. 21); the title says normal occlusion. No profile criterion is stated, so class-I, not class-I-balanced. The text names 'Chen and Zhang'; the reference list gives Chen YX only.
Table II heads Chen's column '12 years, Male'; the text does not give the sex split of the 100.
Not entered (not catalogue measurements; no ratio computed): S-N (63 ± 3), N-ANS and UFH:LFH%.
Table V (p. 24) averages several studies; it is not entered for this study (merge notes).
